dataset_diagnostic.finding: Public train/val injection sets are not email-shaped: almost no label-1 item carries a recipient address or an email send/forward instruction, so the dataset slice contributes few or no email cores. The core library is built from repo probe/fixture material and attributed public email-injection templates (see redteam/adaptive/cores.py).
